alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:6111c4a1-4.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. THE ROLE We're looking for a Customer Marketing Manager who can own the full customer evidence motion at Baseten: building the systems that capture customer stories, running the co-marketing programs that amplify them, and developing the channels and assets that get those stories in front of the right people. Our customers are ML engineers and AI teams deploying serious workloads — and the stories they tell about what they've built matter. We've earned trust with some of the most demanding technical teams in the industry, and this role exists to turn that trust into evidence. Own the single source of truth for what's in flight across all customer co-marketing activity - Coordinate with design, social, and sales to ensure every asset is built, approved, and distributed correctly Customer Evidence & Asset Library - Stand up a Customer Advisory Board (CAB) program - Build a structured customer reference program REQUIREMENTS - 6+ years in customer marketing, product marketing, or a closely related function - Demonstrated track record building customer advocacy programs for technical audiences or at early-stage companies - Strong ability to craft narratives that resonate with developers while articulating clear business value - Experience producing a range of content formats: written case studies, video testimonials, technical blog posts, social content - Comfort engaging directly with technical audiences — you understand developer workflows, tools, and priorities well enough to be credible in the room - Excellent at making complex technical concepts accessible across different audiences and formats - Deeply organized and naturally process-oriented — you build systems, not just outputs - Thrives in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the programs you're running don't exist yet and you're the one building them - Exposure to a variety of ML startups, offering unparalleled learning and networking opportunities. farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:20b5afe3-b4.title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:20b5afe3-b4.description: ABOUT LUXCLUSIF is a technology-driven global B2B platform founded in 2013 and part of the Farfetch Group since 2021. Dedicated to redefining the luxury paradigm by offering premium pre-owned fashion to a global audience, Luxclusif has pioneered the global luxury resale market with advanced data-driven solutions to facilitate the buying and selling of high-end pre-owned items. With operations spread across the globe and strategic warehouses in key locations, we ensure a seamless supply of luxury goods, handling everything from item curation, quality control, and operations logistics to technology integrations and sales, delivering an unmatched resale experience for brands, retailers, and end-customers. TECHNOLOGY Our Tech Team is responsible for designing, developing, and evolving the internal products that power our business. As a B2B company specialising in second-hand luxury items, we rely on technology to optimise every stage of our operations, from buying and inbound logistics to selling and post-sales support. We are a global team with members across Portugal, Brazil, and the Philippines. PORTO Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals. THE ROLE As a Senior Infrastructure Engineer in the Tech Platform team, you will play a critical role in building the foundation of our entire technology ecosystem. Your mission is to engineer a seamless, scalable, and reliable platform that empowers engineering teams to deliver software faster and with higher quality. In this role, you will be a key technical contributor dedicated to evolving our cloud-native infrastructure. You will focus on driving the adoption of Self-Service capabilities and Infrastructure as Code to reduce cognitive load for our developers, while maintaining a high bar for security, resilience, and operational excellence.
responsibilities: Design and build robust cloud-native infrastructure, focusing on automation, scalability, and high availability for our core systems.
Operate and maintain a wide range of infrastructure components, including Linux and Kubernetes-based systems, using automated processes and pipelines.
Drive the creation of self-service capabilities, ensuring that the infrastructure layers we build empower engineering teams across the company to be autonomous.
Ensure the reliability, performance, and scalability of large-scale distributed systems, guaranteeing the platform is robust enough for high-traffic events.
Contribute to technical strategy and roadmaps, ensuring the platform's evolution aligns with global company goals and delivers consistent value.
Act as a key technical partner for Principals, Engineering Leads, and developers, translating business needs into scalable technical solutions to accelerate global productivity.
Identify opportunities to optimize cost efficiency and reliability through automated processes and modern infrastructure patterns.
Provide technical mentorship and guidance to other engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, psychological safety, and continuous learning.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:32b70a21-8a1e-.title: Product Design Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:32b70a21-8a1e-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Product Design Engineer based in Netherlands. As a Product Design Engineer, you’ll combine product design and front-end engineering to take ideas from early exploration through to production. You’ll shape what is worth building, prototype rapidly, and personally turn strong concepts into polished digital experiences. Working within a product squad, you’ll partner closely with software engineers while owning the experience and interface layer. A major focus will be designing human-centred experiences for AI-native products, where users supervise, review, correct, and authorise work performed by intelligent agents. You’ll have substantial influence over product decisions rather than simply executing finished specifications. This is an ideal role for a multidisciplinary builder who values speed, craft, product judgment, and the ability to ship. Explore product opportunities through user research, experimentation, prototyping, and iterative design to identify the strongest solutions. Carry product concepts through to production-ready front-end experiences, combining design decisions and implementation within the same workflow. Help define what is worth building by engaging with users, challenging assumptions, validating problems, and shaping scope with the product squad. Design and build intuitive supervisory interfaces for AI-native workflows, including triage queues, confidence and citation patterns, briefings, and other decision-support experiences. Use AI tools throughout the product development lifecycle, including research, design, prototyping, development, and testing. Evaluate AI-generated outputs critically, applying strong product and design judgment rather than relying on automated results without review. Collaborate closely with software engineers responsible for the underlying systems and ensure the final experience works effectively with the technical architecture. Take ownership of front-end quality, including performance, accessibility, responsive behaviour, cross-device compatibility, and perceived speed. Continuously iterate on products based on user feedback, technical constraints, and real-world usage. Deliver polished, production-ready experiences that balance usability, functionality, technical feasibility, and visual quality. Requirements: Proven experience designing and building front-end products through to production, with ownership of both the experience and implementation. Strong design judgment and visual/product taste, with the ability to distinguish genuinely excellent experiences from interfaces that are merely functional. Strong product instinct and the ability to challenge assumptions, reduce unnecessary scope, and validate ideas with real users. Fluency in modern web development and front-end engineering practices. Demonstrated experience using AI tooling across multiple stages of product development, including research, design, prototyping, coding, and testing. Strong understanding of AI limitations and failure modes, with the ability to identify when AI-generated output appears correct but is not. Experience creating data-rich, complex, or high-stakes interfaces for demanding professional users. Ability to communicate credibly with domain experts and translate complex workflows into clear, effective product experiences. Strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility, performance, and cross-device behaviour. Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary product squad alongside software engineers and other stakeholders. Candidates may come from design, engineering, or multidisciplinary backgrounds; the key requirement is the ability to design, build, and ship high-quality products. Benefits: Fully remote working opportunity within the UK or Europe. Opportunity to combine product design and front-end engineering without traditional handoffs between design

jobgether-jobgether:lever:5b2b5d03-baf5-.title: Senior Staff Engineer – Static Timing Analysis (STA)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:5b2b5d03-baf5-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Staff Engineer – Static Timing Analysis (STA) based in India. This is a senior technical leadership opportunity focused on timing analysis and signoff for complex SoC designs and advanced semiconductor technologies. You will lead block-level and full-chip timing closure across multiple operating modes and corners using sophisticated MMMC methodologies. The role involves solving challenging timing issues alongside synthesis, CTS, place-and-route, extraction, and ECO teams. You will also help define timing constraints, drive optimization, and balance performance, power, and area requirements. A strong emphasis is placed on automation and methodology improvements that increase STA productivity and signoff efficiency. You will work within a fast-moving, highly technical environment where ownership, engineering depth, and practical execution are valued. This is an opportunity to contribute directly to advanced AI/HPC silicon infrastructure and help drive successful tapeout of complex designs. Lead block-level and full-chip Static Timing Analysis (STA) activities, covering setup, hold, recovery, removal, and noise analysis. Drive timing closure across multiple modes and corners using MMMC (Multi-Mode Multi-Corner) methodologies. Analyze, debug, and resolve complex timing violations in collaboration with synthesis, CTS, place-and-route, extraction, and ECO teams. Define and validate timing constraints, including SDC generation, timing exceptions, clock definitions, and related timing requirements . Perform timing signoff using industry-standard STA tools and established signoff methodologies. Drive ECO implementation and timing optimization while balancing performance, power, and area (PPA) objectives. Collaborate with implementation and signoff teams to achieve robust timing convergence and support timely tapeout execution. Contribute to STA automation, methodology enhancements, flow optimization, and productivity initiatives. Improve the efficiency and consistency of timing analysis and signoff processes through scripting and workflow optimization. Support successful timing closure across complex SoC designs while maintaining high signoff quality across all relevant operating conditions. Requirements 10+ years of professional experience in STA, timing closure, physical design signoff, or closely related semiconductor engineering roles. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, VLSI , or a related technical discipline. Strong understanding of STA concepts, including OCV, AOCV, POCV, signal integrity/noise analysis, clocking methodologies, and timing exceptions . Hands-on experience with Synopsys PrimeTime and advanced timing signoff flows. Strong understanding of the semiconductor implementation flow, including synthesis, CTS, place-and-route, extraction, and ECO implementation . Proven ability to drive timing closure across complex designs and multiple modes and corners. Strong scripting and automation capabilities using Tcl, Perl, Python, Shell , or similar languages. Experience troubleshooting complex timing problems and collaborating effectively with cross-functional implementation teams. Experience with advanced-node technologies such as 7nm, 5nm, or below is highly desirable. Exposure to low-power design methodologies, including UPF/CPF and power-aware STA , is a plus. Experience with full-chip timing convergence and successful tapeout execution for large SoC designs is advantageous. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of complex technical challenges. Excellent cross-functional communication and collaboration skills, combined with a hands-on, results-oriented mindset. Benefits Remote work option in India , with the opportunity to work in a hybrid/on-site setup in Bengaluru when applicable. Op

spmb-spmb:lever:08f0de64-3225-414f-be47-.description: Company Overview: SPMB is one of the largest retained executive search firms in North America focused exclusively on technology and innovation. With a 45-year legacy rooted in Silicon Valley, the firm has built leadership teams for disruptive startups and Fortune 500 companies alike, closing more than 400 searches annually. Clients include Google, Amazon, Disney, Comcast, and Major League Baseball. For an associate joining Managing Partner Mike Doonan’s practice, SPMB offers a high-caliber yet human environment that stands apart from both the global giants and boutique firms. SPMB uniquely blends the reach and resources of a large firm with the agility of a boutique. Unlike global firms burdened by “off-limits” restrictions, SPMB can target virtually any candidate while also bringing far greater research capacity than smaller competitors. Its partners are known for rescuing searches that other firms cannot complete, thanks to deep fluency in technology and relentless urgency. Clients consistently cite SPMB’s speed, consultative approach, and ability to deliver fresh candidate slates rather than recycled lists. What sets SPMB apart is its long-term, relationship-driven ethos. The majority of searches come from repeat clients or referrals, a testament to decades of trust built “brick by brick.” The firm prioritizes cultural fit and integrity over transactions, treating candidates with respect and committing to diverse slates for every search. By investing in authentic partnerships, SPMB has created a network where today’s candidates often return as tomorrow’s clients. Even in challenging markets, SPMB has stayed true to this long-game philosophy, focusing on people, process improvements, and employee growth. Every search at SPMB is partner-led, heavily resourced, and executed with precision. The firm’s proprietary 4×4 process aims to present four qualified finalists by week four, supported by dedicated research teams. Radical transparency is delivered through Thrive TRM, a co-developed platform giving clients real-time visibility into every candidate. Today, SPMB serves venture-backed startups, PE-backed growth firms, and global enterprises alike—helping companies of all sizes build the technology leadership needed to thrive in the digital era. Position Overview: SPMB is looking for a thoughtful and professional Associate who will serve as a key member of the client delivery team by driving the candidate development process throughout each VP and C-level executive search. This role partners closely with the Partner and analyst to help deliver outstanding outcomes for our clients. Associates are responsible for working directly with our public and private clients, managing the day-to-day details of search engagements, facilitating discussions with candidates and directing the research activities of internal teams. The core function of the Associate’s role is relationship development and management, including networking and building strong relationships with senior clients and candidates. This role is an unique opportunity to interface with key senior executives as well as investors from the venture capital, private equity and public company community.
responsibilities: Gather key information from the client to gain a thorough understanding of the company, culture and position requirements.
Collaborates with the Partner and analyst to develop and execute the search strategy.
Develops key search documentation including position descriptions, candidate assessments, status updates and reference reference reports.

Teams with the Partner to provide our clients with an informed perspective on candidates and provide updates on the overall progress of the search assignment.
Ensures data capture of candidates, clients and search records within SPMB's databases. Add to the firm’s candidate pool expertise by identifying new talent.

todaytixgroup-todaytixgroup:lever:2c6d8a.title: Lead Data Engineer
todaytixgroup-todaytixgroup:lever:2c6d8a.description: About TodayTix Group: TodayTix Group (TTG) is the global e-commerce leader for cultural experiences, designing frictionless discovery and purchase journeys through innovative product design and industry-leading technology. Our portfolio of brands––including TodayTix, New York Theatre Guide, London Theatre, Show-Score, Arthouse, Arthouse London, and Secret Cinema––connects millions of customers with the best in live entertainment. Powered by vast data and insights, TTG helps theatres, producers, and cultural institutions reach highly engaged audiences and unlock meaningful revenue, transforming how tickets are sold across the world. In 2025, TTG entered a new chapter as part of MARI, the global events and experiences company powering world-defining live experiences. Together, we’re expanding our reach, deepening our impact, and accelerating a shared vision to redefine the event lifecycle through seamless discovery, purchase, and engagement. Life at TodayTix Group We thrive in a nimble, growth-oriented environment where adaptability, curiosity, and a bias toward action help us stay ahead of the curve. We move quickly, iterate often, and expect everyone to take ownership of their impact - because we're building the future of live events, and there’s no script for what comes next. New joiners are set up for success with a 90-day onboarding journey, complete with clear goals and measurable milestones. We believe feedback fuels growth, so we hold twice-yearly performance reviews focused on impact and development. Above all, you’ll be working alongside a team of collaborative, passionate, and kind humans - people who love theatre and live experiences, and who support each other just as much as they challenge each other to do great work. We are seeking outstanding applicants of all backgrounds to join our team to bring new voices, talent, and perspectives to the table. We encourage all to apply. About the Role: We’re looking for a Lead Data Engineer to join TodayTix Group and own how we scale our data platform — the backbone connecting product, growth, finance, and CX to a single source of truth, plus increasingly the substrate AI tooling across the company queries directly. You’ll lead the team that owns the project end-to-end — staging, intermediates, and marts — plus the CI/CD pipeline and Snowflake platform underneath it. This is a technical leadership role, not a heads-down modeling one — most of your time goes to architecture, review, technical strategy, and cross-functional leadership, with hands-on modeling a deliberate minority. You lead by setting direction, raising the team’s bar, and owning delivery, quality, and stakeholder trust across a high-demand roadmap. The foundation is built — your job is what gets built on top of it as the org scales. TTG is expanding as part of MARI, bringing new portfolio companies’ event and ticketing data onto the platform; PxT (our partner-facing product) is growing its surface area; and the business keeps adding markets and brands. You’ll design how the platform absorbs that growth — new sources, new consumers, higher stakes — without the architecture buckling. If you thrive in a fast-moving, high-ownership environment, measure your impact by the team’s, not just your own, and care as much about business impact as technical craft, we’d love to hear from you — especially if, like the rest of the team, you reach for AI by default. Please note:This full-time position and qualified candidates must be based in the greater NYC area. We encourage collaboration by working a minimum of 2 days per week in the office, with flexibility to choose where you work for the rest of the week.
responsibilities: Own the data platform end-to-end — the dbt project (staging → intermediates → marts), CI/CD, and the Snowflake infrastructure it runs on.
Design and lead the onboarding of new data sources onto the platform as TTG scales, so growth doesn’t mean architectural debt.
Partner with data consumers — product, growth, finance, CX, and incoming portfolio teams — to model new sources cleanly rather than bolt them on under deadline pressure.

Run intake and prioritization across a high-demand roadmap where reporting, growth analytics, and AI-tooling initiatives compete for the same team’s time — sequence against business objectives, and say no well.
Protect data quality systematically — dbt tests, contract-enforced schemas, and CI that catches breaking changes before they reach a dashboard or an AI agent.
Set technical direction for the warehouse and give the kind of code review that makes data engineers better — spotting model design flaws before they ship.
Lead and grow the team — 1:1s, feedback, and career development.
Build the factory, not just the models: keep pushing AI into how the team works, and support the org’s growing use of AI agents as direct consumers of the warehouse you build.

About the Role: Powered by TodayTix (PxT) is TodayTix Group's enterprise ticketing and e-commerce division — the technology and tools that help the world's leading cultural organizations, attractions, and live events power their box office and drive online sales. We work with some of the most exciting venues, producers, and event organizers on the planet, and we're building the platform that helps them thrive. This role sits at the heart of our B2B inventory and event management platform, shaping the experience for live event partners who rely on it to run their business. If you’re passionate about making complex tools feel effortless and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, we’d love to hear from you. We encourage collaboration by working a minimum of 2 days per week in the office, while also offering flexibility for employees to choose where they work for the rest of the week.
responsibilities: Lead design across complex B2B product initiatives, from early discovery through delivery and QA.
Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and other designers to define and craft outstanding product experiences.
Lead design reviews and brainstorming sessions, presenting regularly to design leadership and company executives.
Proactively set expectations with stakeholders and communicate clearly when scope or direction shifts.
Promote a culture of design excellence — mentor other designers, champion quality, and lead by example.

Use AI tools fluently across your workflow (research, ideation, prototyping, and production) and help establish best practices for the team. This includes using AI-assisted coding to ship frontend components and maintain design system quality without always relying on a developer.
Partner with developers to ensure designs are implemented accurately and to a high standard.
Regularly use the product to uncover usability issues, identify bugs, and suggest thoughtful improvements.
